description: This file defines a Jekyll plugin filter for converting email addresses into Gravatar URLs within a static site generator workflow.

classes.name: Jekyll::GravatarFilter
classes.description: A module defining a filter to generate Gravatar URLs from email addresses in Jekyll templates.

methods.name: to_gravatar
methods.description: Generates a Gravatar URL for the given email input with optional size parameter.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash of a sanitized email address.
